hints.content:
We can figure out the cost per pound of bananas in the number line.

[[☃ image 2]]

[[☃ image 1]]

In the number line, bananas cost $0.49$ dollars per pound.  Do any of the options have the same price per pound?

options.alt: A number line labeled as Total cost (dollars) is marked with evenly spaced ticks in increments of 0.49. The line extends much further to the right than the left. The number line reads from left to right: 0, 0.49, and 1.47. A curved arrow from 1.47 to 0.49 points 2 units to the left. Divided by 3 is written below this arrow.

A number line labeled as Bananas (pounds) is marked with evenly spaced ticks in increments of 1. The line extends much further to the right than the left. The number line reads from left to right: 0, 1 and 3. A curved arrow from 3 to 1 points 2 units to the left. Divided by 3 is written above this arrow.
